query: INSERT INTO entities (id,kind,name,document,content_hash) SELECT * FROM UNNEST($1::text[],$2::text[],$3::text[],$4::jsonb[],$5::text[]) ON CONFLICT (id) DO UPDATE SET kind=EXCLUDED.kind,name=EXCLUDED.name,document=EXCLUDED.document,content_hash=EXCLUDED.content_hash,retired=false WHERE entities.content_hash <> EXCLUDED.content_hash OR entities.retired
